title: The Genealogy and Birth of Jesus
summary: Matthew opens with a genealogy tracing Jesus from Abraham through David to Joseph, then narrates how an angel tells Joseph in a dream to take Mary as his wife despite her unexplained pregnancy.
blurb: Matthew traces Jesus's genealogy from Abraham to Joseph, then tells how an angel reassures Joseph to take the pregnant Mary as his wife.

title: The Magi and the Flight to Egypt
summary: Magi from the east follow a star to worship the infant Jesus, prompting a threatened Herod to order the killing of Bethlehem's infant boys while Joseph flees with his family to Egypt.
blurb: Magi worship the infant Jesus with gifts, and Joseph flees to Egypt with Mary and Jesus after Herod orders the death of Bethlehem's infant boys.

title: John the Baptist and the Baptism of Jesus
summary: John the Baptist preaches repentance in the wilderness and baptizes Jesus in the Jordan River, where a voice from heaven declares Jesus God's beloved Son as the Spirit descends like a dove.
blurb: John the Baptist preaches repentance and baptizes Jesus, whom a voice from heaven declares God's beloved Son.

title: The Temptation and the First Disciples
summary: Satan tempts Jesus three times in the wilderness and is resisted each time with Scripture, after which Jesus begins preaching in Galilee and calls Peter, Andrew, James, and John to follow him.
blurb: Jesus resists three temptations from Satan in the wilderness, then begins preaching in Galilee and calls his first four disciples.

title: The Beatitudes and the Higher Righteousness
summary: Jesus opens the Sermon on the Mount with the Beatitudes, calls his disciples salt and light, and reinterprets the law's teaching on anger, adultery, oaths, retaliation, and love for one's enemies.
blurb: Jesus teaches the Beatitudes and calls his disciples to a righteousness that exceeds the scribes and Pharisees.

title: Prayer, Fasting, and Treasure in Heaven
summary: Jesus teaches his disciples to give, pray, and fast without seeking human praise, gives them the Lord's Prayer, and tells them to store up treasure in heaven instead of being anxious about food or clothing.
blurb: Jesus teaches the Lord's Prayer and calls his disciples to store up treasure in heaven rather than worry about earthly needs.

title: The Narrow Gate and the Wise and Foolish Builders
summary: Jesus warns against judging others, tells his disciples to ask, seek, and knock, warns against false prophets, and closes the sermon with the parable of the wise man who builds on rock and the foolish man who builds on sand.
blurb: Jesus warns against judging others and false prophets, and closes the sermon with the parable of the wise and foolish builders.

title: Jesus Heals a Leper and a Centurion's Servant
summary: Jesus heals a leper and heals a Roman centurion's servant from a distance after commending the centurion's faith, then calms a violent storm and casts a legion of demons out of two men.
blurb: Jesus heals a leper and a centurion's servant, calms a storm, and casts demons out of two men into a herd of pigs.

title: Jesus Forgives a Paralytic and Calls Matthew
summary: Jesus forgives and heals a paralyzed man lowered through a roof, then calls the tax collector Matthew to follow him, eats with sinners, heals a bleeding woman, and raises a ruler's daughter from death.
blurb: Jesus forgives a paralyzed man, calls Matthew the tax collector, and heals a bleeding woman and a dead girl.

title: Jesus Sends Out the Twelve
summary: Jesus names his twelve apostles, gives them authority over unclean spirits and disease, and sends them out to Israel with instructions to travel light and warnings of the persecution they will face.
blurb: Jesus names his twelve apostles and sends them out to Israel with authority to heal and warnings of persecution to come.

title: John the Baptist's Question and Jesus's Invitation
summary: John the Baptist, imprisoned, sends disciples to ask if Jesus is the one to come, and Jesus points to his works as the answer, denounces unrepentant Galilean towns, and invites the weary to find rest in him.
blurb: John the Baptist questions Jesus from prison, and Jesus invites the weary and burdened to find rest in him.

title: Sabbath Controversies and the Sign of Jonah
summary: Jesus is accused of breaking the Sabbath and heals a man's withered hand in the synagogue, then is accused of casting out demons by Beelzebul and warns that only the sign of Jonah will be given.
blurb: Jesus is accused of breaking the Sabbath and casting out demons by Beelzebul, and points to the sign of Jonah instead.

title: The Parables of the Kingdom
summary: Jesus teaches the parables of the sower, the weeds, the mustard seed, the leaven, the hidden treasure, the pearl of great price, and the net, then is rejected by the people of his hometown.
blurb: Jesus teaches a series of parables about the kingdom of heaven, then is rejected by his hometown of Nazareth.

title: The Death of John the Baptist and Miracles on the Sea
summary: Herod Antipas beheads John the Baptist to keep a rash oath, after which Jesus feeds five thousand people with five loaves and two fish, then walks on the water to his disciples during a storm.
blurb: Herod beheads John the Baptist, and Jesus feeds five thousand people and walks on water to his disciples.

title: Tradition, a Canaanite Woman's Faith, and Feeding Four Thousand
summary: Jesus rebukes the Pharisees for elevating human tradition over God's commandments, heals a Canaanite woman's daughter because of her persistent faith, and feeds four thousand people with seven loaves and a few fish.
blurb: Jesus rebukes the Pharisees over tradition, heals a Canaanite woman's daughter, and feeds four thousand people.

title: Peter's Confession and the First Passion Prediction
summary: Jesus warns his disciples against the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees, then at Caesarea Philippi Peter confesses him as the Christ, and Jesus begins predicting his death and resurrection in Jerusalem.
blurb: At Caesarea Philippi, Peter confesses Jesus as the Christ, and Jesus begins predicting his coming death and resurrection.

title: The Transfiguration
summary: Jesus is transfigured on a mountain before Peter, James, and John as Moses and Elijah appear, then comes down to heal a boy his disciples could not heal and predicts his death a second time.
blurb: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John, his face shining as Moses and Elijah appear beside him.

title: Humility, Lost Sheep, and Forgiveness
summary: Jesus calls his disciples to become like children, warns against causing a little one to sin, tells the parable of the lost sheep, gives instructions for confronting sin, and calls Peter to forgive without limit.
blurb: Jesus calls his disciples to childlike humility and tells Peter to forgive not seven times but seventy-seven times.

title: Divorce, Children, and the Rich Young Man
summary: Jesus teaches on divorce and blesses little children brought to him, then a rich young man turns away sad after Jesus tells him to sell his possessions, prompting a warning about wealth and the kingdom.
blurb: Jesus teaches on divorce and blesses children, then a rich young man turns away sad rather than sell his possessions.

title: The Workers in the Vineyard and the Sons of Zebedee
summary: Jesus tells the parable of the workers in the vineyard who all receive the same wage, predicts his death a third time, and heals two blind men at Jericho after the mother of James and John asks for their honor.
blurb: Jesus tells the parable of the workers in the vineyard and heals two blind men crying out to him at Jericho.

title: The Triumphal Entry and Cleansing of the Temple
summary: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey as crowds hail him, drives the money changers out of the temple, curses a fig tree that withers, and tells the parables of the two sons and the wicked tenants.
blurb: Jesus enters Jerusalem to acclaim, cleanses the temple, and confronts the religious leaders with the parable of the wicked tenants.

title: Parables and Questions in the Temple
summary: Jesus tells the parable of the wedding feast, answers a question about paying taxes to Caesar, silences the Sadducees on the resurrection, names the greatest commandments, and stumps the Pharisees over whose son the Christ is.
blurb: Jesus answers questions about taxes, resurrection, and the greatest commandment, then stumps the Pharisees over the identity of the Christ.

title: Woes on the Scribes and Pharisees
summary: Jesus warns the crowds against the hypocrisy of the scribes and Pharisees, pronounces seven woes on them for their hypocrisy, and laments over Jerusalem's rejection of the prophets sent to it.
blurb: Jesus pronounces seven woes on the scribes and Pharisees and laments over Jerusalem's rejection of God's prophets.

title: The Olivet Discourse: Signs of the End
summary: Jesus predicts the temple's destruction, describes wars and persecutions as the beginning of birth pains, and describes his coming as sudden and visible, warning his disciples to stay watchful since no one knows the day or hour.
blurb: Jesus predicts the temple's destruction and describes the signs of his coming, warning his disciples to stay watchful.

title: The Virgins, the Talents, and the Sheep and Goats
summary: Jesus tells the parable of the ten virgins waiting for the bridegroom and the parable of the talents entrusted to three servants, then describes the final judgment separating the sheep from the goats.
blurb: Jesus tells the parables of the ten virgins and the talents, then describes the final judgment of the sheep and goats.

title: The Last Supper and Gethsemane
summary: Judas agrees to betray Jesus for thirty pieces of silver, Jesus shares the Passover meal with his disciples and institutes the Lord's Supper, prays in anguish at Gethsemane, is arrested, and is condemned by the Sanhedrin while Peter denies him three times.
blurb: Jesus institutes the Lord's Supper, prays at Gethsemane, is arrested and tried, while Peter denies him three times.

title: The Crucifixion
summary: Judas hangs himself in remorse, Pilate hands Jesus over to be crucified after the crowd chooses to release Barabbas instead, and Jesus is mocked, crucified, and dies before being buried in Joseph of Arimathea's tomb.
blurb: Pilate hands Jesus over to be crucified after the crowd chooses Barabbas, and Jesus dies and is buried in a borrowed tomb.

title: The Resurrection and the Great Commission
summary: An angel rolls away the stone from the empty tomb and tells the women Jesus has risen, and Jesus commissions his eleven disciples on a mountain in Galilee to make disciples of all nations.
blurb: Jesus rises from the dead and commissions his eleven disciples to make disciples of all nations.
